query:
SELECT r.id,
                   r.name,
                   r.description,
                   r.cover_file_reference_id,
                   r.created_by,
                   r.closed_at,
                   EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1 FROM room_bans rb
                       WHERE rb.room_id = r.id
                         AND rb.revoked_at IS NULL
                         AND (rb.ends_at IS NULL OR rb.ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
                   ) AS is_banned,
                   r.created_at,
                   r.updated_at,
                   r.deleted_at,
                   r.version,
                   r.last_activity_at
            FROM rooms r
            WHERE r.id = $1 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
